string.text: Re-rifling the barrel
Changing the pitch of the rifling in the bore of a weapon allows you to increase the initial speed of the bullet and reduce the spread of hits when firing.
Recoil compensator
A barrel with an integrated compensator reduces felt recoil from the shot.
Barrel adjustment
Allows you to reduce the spread of bullets when firing a weapon, which increases the accuracy and accuracy of fire.
Protective coating
Applying a special coating to weapon parts helps slow down their wear.
Soft trigger trigger
Allows you to reduce recoil, facilitating more accurate shooting.
Rubberized handle
Provides a more comfortable grip and thus allows you to achieve better results when shooting.
Adjusting the locking mechanism
By locking the bore more tightly, the obturation of the bore improves and the muzzle velocity of the bullet increases.
Chamber adjustment
Eliminating backlash allows you to achieve higher shooting accuracy.
Reinforced frame
Reinforcing the frame allows you to increase the service life of the weapon.
Refinement of the extractor
Allows you to reduce the number of delays associated with the sticking of cartridges ejected from the pistol after firing.
Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Forcing USM
Reconfiguring the trigger and modifying some of its parts allows firing at a higher rate.Unfortunately, this causes the weapon to wear out a little faster.
Polymer buffer
The introduction of an additional polymer buffer into the recoil mechanism reduces the recoil felt by the shooter.
Wear-resistant USM
Replacing standard trigger parts with high-strength analogues allows you to extend the service life of the weapon and ensure its trouble-free operation in the harsh conditions of the Zone.
